timeline.summary: Orient Technologies filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹43.75 Cr unutilized IPO proceeds with deployment extended to FY27.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹184.07 Cr, net loss ₹4.99 Cr.
Orient Technologies' CFO Gourav Modi resigned for personal reasons effective 25 June 2026; the board accepted it at the 27 May 2026 meeting that also approved FY26 results.
Orient Technologies announced FY26 standalone revenue of ₹870.67 crore and highlighted strategic enterprise wins with an order book of ₹400 crore for FY27.
